x-groups.title: Connection
x-groups.description: The AWS account and region, and how to sign in.

x-groups.title: Streams
x-groups.description: Which streams the source offers, and where their first read starts.

x-groups.title: Records
x-groups.description: How each record's data is encoded.

x-groups.title: Retries
x-groups.description: Backoff and limits for throttled calls.

region.title: Region
region.description: The streams' AWS region. Unset: the AWS default configuration's.

accessKeyId.title: Access key ID
accessKeyId.description: An AWS access key, with secretAccessKey. Without one, the credentials of the role in aws.role, or the AWS default credentials.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: A Kinesis-compatible endpoint: a VPC endpoint's, or an emulator's. Unset: the region's.

streams.title: Streams
streams.description: The Kinesis streams to offer as streams. Empty: every stream the credentials can list.

streamPattern.title: Stream pattern
streamPattern.description: A regular expression, in Go's syntax, that streams must match to be offered.

startPosition.title: Start position

oneOf.title: Earliest
oneOf.description: Each shard's oldest record the stream still holds.

oneOf.title: Latest
oneOf.description: Records that arrive after the first read starts.

oneOf.title: At a time
oneOf.description: From 0.2.0. Records that arrived at or after startTimestamp.

startPosition.description: Where a stream's first read starts. Later reads resume where the last one stopped.

startTimestamp.title: Start time
startTimestamp.description: From 0.2.0. With startPosition timestamp: the first read starts at the records that arrived at or after this time, in RFC 3339. Records older than the stream's retention are gone. It must have passed: Kinesis starts a read only at a time that has, so a time in the future fails the preflight, and a first read fails with CONFIG_INVALID.

type.title: Consumer type

oneOf.title: Shared throughput
oneOf.description: GetRecords, polling each shard. Readers of a shard share its 2 MB a second and 5 calls a second.

oneOf.title: Enhanced fan-out
oneOf.description: A consumer registered for the pipeline, with 2 MB a second of its own per shard, pushed with SubscribeToShard. Kinesis charges for it, and allows 20 per stream, or 50 for an On-demand Advantage stream.

type.description: How shards are read: by polling, sharing each shard's throughput, or with enhanced fan-out.

name.title: Consumer name
name.description: The enhanced fan-out consumer's name. The first read registers it on each stream it reads. Unset: openetl- and the pipeline's name, or where that name has characters a consumer's can't or is longer than 120 characters, those replaced with - or cut, then - and a hash of the whole name. Give each pipeline its own: a shard takes one subscription per consumer.

deregisterOnTeardown.title: Deregister on teardown
deregisterOnTeardown.description: Deregister the consumer from the streams once the pipeline is deleted.

polling.title: Polling
polling.description: From 0.2.0. How each shard is polled with GetRecords.

maxRecords.title: Records per call
maxRecords.description: The most records one GetRecords returns.

interval.description: The least time between two GetRecords of a shard. Kinesis allows five a second per shard, shared by every reader of the shard.
interval.title: Interval

idleInterval.description: The time between two GetRecords of a shard after one returned nothing. At least interval. Unset: 1s, or interval if that's longer.
idleInterval.title: Idle interval

deaggregate.title: De-aggregate KPL records
deaggregate.description: From 0.2.0. Split records the Kinesis Producer Library aggregated into their user records, a row each. Off: an aggregated record fails the read, whatever the format.

format.title: Format

oneOf.title: JSON
oneOf.description: Each record's data is a JSON value.

oneOf.title: Text
oneOf.description: Each record's data is read as text, in value.

format.description: How records' data is encoded. Avro and Protobuf use the schema registry's wire format; string reads each record as text.

schemaRegistryUrl.title: Schema registry URL
schemaRegistryUrl.description: A Confluent-compatible schema registry. Avro and Protobuf need one.

schemaRegistryUsername.title: Schema registry user
schemaRegistryUsername.description: A user for the schema registry's basic authentication, which sends the password as it is: use an https schemaRegistryUrl. Unset: none.

retry.title: Retries
retry.description: From 0.2.0. How calls that Kinesis throttles, or that fail for a moment, are retried.

initialBackoff.description: The first wait before a retry. Each wait is drawn at random up to this, doubled for each retry in a row, up to maxBackoff.
initialBackoff.title: Initial backoff

maxBackoff.description: The longest wait before a retry.
maxBackoff.title: Longest backoff

maxAttempts.title: Attempts per call
maxAttempts.description: How many times the AWS SDK tries one call, the first included, before it gives up on it.

maxElapsed.description: How long a shard's reads may be throttled without a call getting through before the read fails with RATE_LIMITED. No wait between retries runs past it.
maxElapsed.title: Longest throttling
